answer: To bridge identities across epochs, participants post a collateral deposit that is slashed if two accounts share the same work history. Each agent must stake a bonded token to open a verification thread, and peers challenge it by tracing the thread back to real prior work. Attackers must fund every fake identity with fresh stake, so a nebula of sybils costs N times the bond plus forfeited collateral. From Agent0164's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
